hooks.command: [ -f .claude/timonel.config.json ] || [ -f .claude-plugin/plugin.json ] || echo '[timonel] No existe .claude/timonel.config.json en este repo. Ejecuta /timonel:onboard para generarlo.'

[ -f .claude/timonel.config.json ] || exit 0; command -v gh >/dev/null || exit 0; [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] || exit 0; mkdir -p .timonel; cache=.timonel/.latest-release; if [ ! -f "$cache" ] || [ -n "$(find "$cache" -mtime +1 2>/dev/null)" ]; then gh release view --repo luisfelipediaz/Harness.Timonel --json tagName -q .tagName 2>/dev/null > "$cache" || true; fi; latest=$(sed 's/^v//' "$cache" 2>/dev/null); local=$(jq -r .version "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$latest" ] && [ -n "$local" ] && [ "$latest" != "$local" ] && echo "[timonel] Hay una version nueva del plugin: $latest (instalada $local). Ejecuta: claude plugin update timonel@luisfelipediaz-harness" || true

es_plugin=0; [ -f .claude-plugin/plugin.json ] && jq -e '.name=="timonel"' .claude-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && es_plugin=1; [ "$es_plugin" = 1 ] || exit 0; [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] || exit 0; version_repo=$(jq -r '.version // empty' .claude-plugin/plugin.json 2>/dev/null); version_instalada=$(jq -r '.version // empty' "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$version_repo" ] && [ -n "$version_instalada" ] || exit 0; [ "$version_repo" = "$version_instalada" ] && exit 0; echo "[timonel] Los agentes de esta sesion corren con la version instalada ($version_instalada); el repo tiene la version $version_repo. flechodiezx y flechodiezx-hotfix releen agents/*.md del repo al detectar esta diferencia."

mkdir -p .timonel 2>/dev/null && jq -r 'if (.tool_input.command // "") | test("gh issue (create|close|edit|comment)") then "[" + (now | strftime("%H:%M:%S")) + "][gh] " + ((.tool_input.command | split(" ") | .[0:3] | join(" ")) // "?") else empty end' 2>/dev/null >> .timonel/events.log || true

[ -f .claude/timonel.config.json ] || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // ""' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; rel=${f#$PWD/}; m=$(jq -r '[.api.moduleFile, (.frontends[]?.routesFile), (.modelos.path + "/")] | map(select(. != null and . != "/")) | .[]' .claude/timonel.config.json 2>/dev/null); for p in $m; do case "$rel" in "$p"|"$p"*) echo "[timonel] Aviso: editaste un archivo raiz del harness ($rel). Solo el orquestador (Fase 2 modelos / consolidate-story) debe tocarlo; si eres sub-agente, revierte y documentalo en tu output."; mkdir -p .timonel && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) raiz-editada $rel" >> .timonel/events.log; exit 0;; esac; done; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null); script="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/scripts/detectar_commit.py"; [ -f "$script" ] || script=./scripts/detectar_commit.py; if [ -f "$script" ]; then printf '%s' "$cmd" | python3 "$script" >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; else rc=3; fi; case "$rc" in 0) ;; 1) exit 0 ;; *) case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac ;; esac; [ -f .claude-plugin/plugin.json ] && jq -e '.name=="timonel"' .claude-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; dir=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | sed -nE 's#.*git[[:space:]]+-C[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+).*#\1#p' | head -1); [ -n "$dir" ] || dir=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | sed -nE 's#^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+([^&;|]+).*#\1#p' | head -1 | sed 's#[[:space:]]*$##'); [ -n "$dir" ] && [ -d "$dir" ] || dir=.; branch=$(git -C "$dir" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = main ] || [ "$branch" = master ]; then echo '[timonel] Bloqueado: en Harness.Timonel no se commitea directo en main. Crea la rama de la historia (git checkout -b hu/<issue>-<slug>); la integracion a main se hace por Pull Request con merge humano (TIM-ADR-0005, epica #79/#80).' >&2; exit 2; fi; printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9])#[0-9]+' && exit 0; echo '[timonel] Bloqueado: todo commit en Harness.Timonel debe referenciar un issue (#N). Crea el issue (gh issue create o /timonel:draft) y cita su numero en el mensaje (TIM-ADR-0005).' >&2; exit 2

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null); es_plugin=0; [ -f .claude-plugin/plugin.json ] && jq -e '.name=="timonel"' .claude-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && es_plugin=1; [ -f .claude/timonel.config.json ] || [ "$es_plugin" = 1 ] || exit 0; case "$cmd" in *'push'*'--force'*|*'push -f'*) echo '[timonel] Bloqueado: git push --force esta prohibido por el harness (usa --force-with-lease solo con aprobacion explicita del usuario).' >&2; exit 2;; esac; script="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/scripts/detectar_commit.py"; if [ ! -f "$script" ] && [ "$es_plugin" = 1 ]; then script=./scripts/detectar_commit.py; fi; if [ -f "$script" ]; then printf '%s' "$cmd" | python3 "$script" >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; else rc=3; fi; case "$rc" in 0) ;; 1) exit 0 ;; *) case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac ;; esac; dir=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | sed -nE 's#.*git[[:space:]]+-C[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+).*#\1#p' | head -1); [ -n "$dir" ] || dir=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | sed -nE 's#^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+([^&;|]+).*#\1#p' | head -1 | sed 's#[[:space:]]*$##'); [ -n "$dir" ] && [ -d "$dir" ] || dir=.; branch=$(git -C "$dir" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$branch" ] || exit 0; bases=$(jq -r '(.git.baseBranches // ["main","master","develop"]) | join(" ")' .claude/timonel.config.json 2>/dev/null); for b in $bases; do if [ "$branch" = "$b" ]; then echo "[timonel] Bloqueado: commit directo en la rama base '$branch'. Crea la rama de la historia (git checkout -b hu/<issue>-<slug>); todo cambio entra por PR, sin excepcion de config (TIM-ADR-0005, epica #79/#85)." >&2; exit 2; fi; done; case "$branch" in hu/*) n=$(printf '%s' "$branch" | sed -E 's#^hu/([0-9]+).*#\1#'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9])#$n([^0-9]|$)" || { echo "[timonel] Bloqueado: en la rama $branch el commit debe referenciar #$n (ej. 'feat(modulo): ... #$n')." >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0

es_plugin=0; [ -f .claude-plugin/plugin.json ] && jq -e '.name=="timonel"' .claude-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && es_plugin=1; c=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); principal=0; case "$c" in */.git) [ -f "${c%/.git}/.claude/timonel.config.json" ] && principal=1;; esac; [ -f .claude/timonel.config.json ] || [ "$principal" = 1 ] || [ "$es_plugin" = 1 ] || exit 0; script="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/scripts/guard_integracion.py"; if [ ! -f "$script" ] && [ "$es_plugin" = 1 ]; then script=./scripts/guard_integracion.py; fi; [ -f "$script" ] || exit 0; python3 "$script"
